gold: Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension

selector.rationale: The presence of mutant IDH-1 protein and loss of ATRX protein in the vitreous biopsy supports the diagnosis of IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, which is a more specific entity than Glioma.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: Although the Ki-67 proliferation index is ~10%, which is relatively high, the presence of mutant IDH-1 protein and loss of ATRX protein is more consistent with IDH-mutant Astrocytoma than Glioblastoma.

rejected.label: Astrocytic Neoplasm
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, but the specific molecular features support the more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: This is a secondary complication that occurred after the initial presentation, and the underlying cause is the astrocytic neoplasm.
